definitions.gloss: long-cherished wish; heart's desire; long-held dream
definitions.explanation: A wish or goal that someone has held for a long time. Used when that wish is finally fulfilled or when describing something someone has always wanted.

examples.japanese: {念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
{念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マイホーム→マイホーム：27323_maihoomu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I finally got the home I had always dreamed of.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}{越|ご}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{念願|ねんがん}だった⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ついに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was finally able to take the overseas trip I had been dreaming about for over ten years.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the pattern {念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun, meaning "the long-desired [noun]." The most common combination is {念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧ (a long-held dream comes true). Often appears in happy announcements or celebrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧ (long-cherished dream)
- {念願|ねんがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧ (a long-held wish comes true)
- {念願|ねんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧ (long-desired championship victory)
- {念願|ねんがん}だった + noun (the [noun] one had always wished for)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲願|ひがん}→悲願：21839_higan⟧: heartfelt wish — stronger and more serious; often used for groups or organizations striving toward a difficult goal
- ⟦{願望|がんぼう}→願望：05085_ganbou⟧: desire, wish — more general; does not imply a long period of wanting
